title: Approve the ADR set; no external heartbeat; manual backups
decision: Accept ADR-001 to ADR-014; observability is logs, metrics and in-app owner alerts without an external heartbeat; backups are manual dumps by the owner with no automated off-site copy
context: Hobby project on the owner's daily-use PC; data is easy to recreate and its loss is acceptable to the owner
chosen_option: Minimal operations: in-app observability only and manual backups
rationale: Simplicity and zero vendor dependency fit the stakes; residual risks are explicit and owned by the owner
